refnamediv.refpurpose: Execute command via shell and return the complete output as a string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
stringfalsenullshell_exec stringcommand
This function is identical to the backtick operator, which is deprecated as of PHP 8.5.0 (an E_DEPRECATED is emitted).
On Windows, the underlying pipe is opened in text mode which can cause the function to fail for binary output. Consider to use popen instead for such cases.
